restaurantName: Hiệu Lực Canh Cá Rô Hưng Yên (Hoàn Kiếm)
address: 39 Hai Ba Trung Street, Hoan Kiem Ward, Hanoi, 111000, Vietnam
bio: These speciality rice noodles from Hưng Yên Province are topped with crispy deep-fried climbing perch and bouncy fish cakes for umami; mustard greens and green onions add freshness. Diners choose between silky flat rice noodles and plump red grain noodles for a perfect bite.
pageTitle: Hiệu Lực Canh Cá Rô Hưng Yên (Hoàn Kiếm)
